targetPage.description: target page name of this link.

internal.description: Whether the link should be treated as an internal application link or an external link.

opensNewTab.description: Whether clicking the link to a new page will open a new tab.

download.description: Whether clicking the link download a file.

downloadFileName.description:
New filename of the downloaded file.

If not specified, the original filename of the downloaded file will be used.

urlEncode.description: Whether the interpolated parameters in the link should be url encoded or not.

text.description: The human readable name of the link to display as text.
